summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 2024 Official Live Stream Episode 1 Part 2 ## Introduction First of all, I would like to thank Mr. Zach for sharing with us. Please follow Mr. Zach's ArtStation account after the live broadcast. The next part of our Marvelous Designer team preparation is the content of our physical properties summary. ## Overview of Physical Properties Before I officially tell you about our physical properties, I need to describe some of the settings in our software. I am playing a recorded video, so during the viewing process, I will pause to see your chats and answer your questions. ### Fabric Window In Marvelous Designer, when we are in the Fabric window, after selecting a fabric, its specific properties will appear in the property editor at the bottom. After selecting a fabric, we can click on its preset to select the preset fabric properties at the bottom. In the latest version, when we hover the mouse over these preset fabrics, we can see the effect of these fabrics on a ball, which helps us understand the texture. ### Physical Properties Adjustment At the bottom, we can see its specific properties and detail adjustments. When we adjust the physical properties, we have several options. First of all, these values are adjusted by four groups. For example, the strength of the gold tail gauze is divided into four groups. The bend strength is also divided into four groups. The strength of the gold tail gauze, although its name is gold tail gauze, and the bottom is the tension of the right foot line. The tension of the right foot line refers to the stretch of the right foot line. ### Understanding Fabric Direction How do we know what the gold tail gauze of the fabric represents? We need to use the editing text tool to select the sheet. An arrow on this sheet indicates its gold shape, which has a 90-degree angle. In the video, the orange position is our tail. This distinction between gold shape and tail shape is due to the two directions of clothing fabric: the gold shape and the tail shape. The different directions are due to the varying strength of the gauze lines themselves, which affect their physical properties. ## Modifying Fabric Position In Marvelous Designer, you are rotating the gold tail gauze.
